text: The 380 kV GIS shall be indoors in a ventilated building with salt filtration (ER-11.01). Outdoor insulation (bushings, insulators, surge arresters, cable terminations) shall be designed for the very heavy pollution class of IEC 60815 with the salt aerosol and chloride deposition of DP-OWNR-0005 and DP-OWNR-0007 (ER-02.10), with the specific creepage of the class for the highest system voltage; the pollution class and creepage shall be confirmed by the insulation coordination study.
